cs.AI.title: Advances in Large Language Models for Reasoning Tasks
cs.AI.authors: Jane Smith, John Doe, et al.
cs.AI.summary: This paper presents a comprehensive study of reasoning capabilities in large language models. We introduce a new benchmark and demonstrate significant improvements in logical reasoning tasks through novel training techniques. Our approach shows a 15% improvement over previous state-of-the-art methods.

cs.AI.title: Neural Architecture Search for Efficient AI Systems
cs.AI.authors: Alice Johnson, Bob Williams, et al.
cs.AI.summary: We propose an automated neural architecture search method that optimizes for both accuracy and computational efficiency. Our approach reduces inference time by 40% while maintaining comparable accuracy to manually designed architectures.

cs.LG.title: Self-Supervised Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding
cs.LG.authors: Charlie Brown, Diana Lee, et al.
cs.LG.summary: This work introduces a novel self-supervised learning framework based on contrastive predictive coding. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results on several benchmark datasets without requiring labeled data. The method shows particular promise for low-resource scenarios.
